en: Black‑and‑white interior view of an opulent hotel lobby or lounge, featuring high ceilings with ornate plasterwork, large round columns, and wide archways. The tiled floor has an intricate repeating pattern. The room is filled with heavy Victorian or Edwardian‑style upholstered armchairs, settees, rocking chairs, side tables, and potted palms; a carved square table with a vase of flowers stands to the right. The image has a white border and appears slightly worn, characteristic of an early 20th‑century postcard photograph.
